add_library(gemmini-runtime OBJECT EXCLUDE_FROM_ALL "${LIB_DIR}/CRunnerUtils.cpp" "${LIB_DIR}/native_trace.cpp"
  "${RUNTIME_DIR}/trace/trace.cpp" "${RUNTIME_DIR}/trace/cycle_file.cpp"
)
target_include_directories(gemmini-runtime
  PRIVATE "${RUNTIME_DIR}/trace"
          "${BUDDY_SOURCE}/llvm/mlir/include/mlir/ExecutionEngine"
)
# The runners are shared libraries.
set_target_properties(gemmini-runtime
  PROPERTIES POSITION_INDEPENDENT_CODE ON
)

add_subdirectory("${LIB_DIR}" image-runtime EXCLUDE_FROM_ALL)

# DESIGN_CMAKE is the description of a Gemmini device config, generated by
# `bbdev stack --build "--config gemmini/devices/gemmini/configs/<Config>.toml
# --device gemmini"`: the programs of the device (<model>-model-baremetal,
# for its RTL) take its layout and boot from it.
include("${DESIGN_CMAKE}")
set(BOOT_DIR "${STACK_ROOT}/runtime/boot")
list(TRANSFORM DESIGN_DEFS PREPEND "-D" OUTPUT_VARIABLE DESIGN_DEFINES)
list(
  APPEND DESIGN_DEFINES
  "-DDEVICE_TRACE_BASE=${DESIGN_DEVICE_TRACE_BASE}ULL"
  "-DDEVICE_TRACE_STRIDE=${DESIGN_DEVICE_TRACE_STRIDE}ULL"
)

# The recipes' checks run the compiled models on spike with the Gemmini
# extension: the gemmini-spike of the Gemmini hart's reference.
set(GEMMINI_SPIKE "" CACHE FILEPATH "spike with the Gemmini extension")

if(MODEL)
  add_subdirectory("${MODEL}")
else()
  add_subdirectory(alexnet)
  add_subdirectory(bert-base-uncased-emotion)
  add_subdirectory(lenet)
  add_subdirectory(mobilenet-v3-small)
  add_subdirectory(resnet18)
  add_subdirectory(yolo26n)
endif()
